doc: scripts/eval_relations.py --gate exits 1 when a metric breaks a bound; a metric the run did not compute (corpus, timing sample) is not gated. Only the integrator edits this file, after each merge, and only upward for min / downward for max (plan §4, §5.3). *_gated metrics leave out the ambiguous eval rows. corpus_relation_flags: the plan's bound was 50; the integration measured 87, every one reviewed on its board as a real error (attack1030/integrate/corpus_flags_review.md); the review fixes add 3 and drop 1 (89), reviewed on their boards — dropped: «ферзь заодно бьёт пешку d6 и давит на f7» («бьёт» is «attacks» too, and on the board without the capture it is true: no verdict); added: two real errors («слон b3 атакован пешкой e6», «конь g4 ничем не защищён» with Bc8 on the diagonal) and one the corpus context makes (stand2/st4: the harness takes the student's colour from a later «я белыми» while the board is the earlier game; the legacy owner check flags it the same) — the bound is the measured count, so a new flag fails the gate until it is reviewed. relation_p99_corpus_ms: relation_issues on the real corpus sentences alone (review 30.10, wiring: the eval rows are short). Integration 31.10 stage 1 (P3A+P3B+P3D+P1): 89 → 100, +11 against WP-0, each reviewed on its board as a real error — target rows castle-ru, lucena, r-notation, can-scotch, plan-caro-adv, st2#4 (cut); op-ruy (target) and opera (stretch) logged by the shadow detectors pin_noun / loaded_line; outside the targets: «Заодно ты подставляешь свою ладью a8 под связку» and «ладья на c6 связывает чёрные фигуры и не даёт им спокойно развязаться» (pin_noun shadow: nothing is pinned on any board the sentence may mean), «конь на g1 и слон на f1 пока заперты» after 1.e4 e5 (locked: the knight has 3 moves, the bishop 5). eval_set row 279 (st2#5, «твоя пешка с f6 забрала слона на e7») relabelled FALSE: it is the graded prod error, the student plays Black. corpus_sentences (min, review-wiring2 01.11): the corpus the gate reads must be the whole local production run — a worktree that cannot find local-preview/prod-run reads fewer sentences and fails here instead of passing on a smaller corpus.
